notes: One-electron SI couplings are Slater–Condon elements over the Fock matrices of the microstates, the bra/ket mean for an excitation (§si-hamiltonian); SSR energies and state properties follow from them.
SI gradients and NAC are analytic with meta-GGA functionals (§state-gradient, §nac); Laplacian-dependent meta-GGAs are rejected with an input error.
NTO holes, NDOs, state natural orbitals and EKT eigenvectors are in a canonical basis of each degenerate span (§nto, §natural-orbitals).
Each SI cassette is solved by LAPACK (every root) or by block Davidson (the lowest roots), §si_reks_solver; on a Davidson cassette a count -1 means the 50 lowest roots (§si-solver, §si-davidson).

§si_reks_grad, §si_reks_nac, §si_reks_property_for and §si_reks_store_states take one entry per SI cassette in the spin order of §si_reks_2spin (spin groups as listed there, cassettes of a group in their §si_reks_configs order); the printed K stays in ascending 2S (§cassette-order).
The SI-only FONs stay in [m, 2 − m], m set by the SI FON bound margin (§si-only-fons, §fon-micro).
